title: Chiefs' Rashee Rice to be jailed for probation violation, to miss OTAs and minicamp after knee surgery

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Chiefs' Rashee Rice to be jailed for probation violation, to miss OTAs and minicamp after knee surgery
sources.description: The Chiefs' wide receiver will serve a 30-day jail sentence after violating probation tied to a 2024 multi-car crash, forcing him to miss OTAs and mandatory minicamp
